Haitian Immigrant Dies by Apparent Suicide Amidst ICE Crackdown

A 20-year-old Haitian student died by apparent suicide, with his family attributing the death to the stress caused by an ankle monitor and a broader Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) crackdown. The student, who was reportedly despondent over wearing the ankle monitor, died in what is being described as an apparent suicide. His family has explicitly blamed ICE's policies for his death. The incident highlights the psychological toll of immigration enforcement measures on individuals.
